rationale: W0, one shot. A diagonal operator on four cosine modes of the front contour: the mean front keeps the velocity the prefix shows, the shape modes relax at curvature-smoothing rates and their drift fades. Twelve coefficients and three assumed-spread numbers, written from front kinematics. No metric BASS observation exists in this repository, so these numbers have never been scored; the forward refuses pixel-only contours. See edits.wsp.
